The generic contract works if callable arguments follow pullback order and static parameters are closed over.

Operation Native pullback result Required handling
solve (Ā, B̄) Direct
sphere (k̄0, r̄, ε̄, μ̄, κ̄) Supply all five dynamic inputs or explicitly project optional material gradients
cluster (r̄, positions̄, ε̄, k̄0) Reorder; differs from function signature
eig Ā Splat two output cotangents; supply zeros for unused output
smatrix_illuminate (lower̄, upper̄, up̄, down̄) Direct; output (4, modes, illuminations)
plane_field (coefficients̄, points̄, vectors̄) Operator variant with coefficients=None must omit empty first gradient
lattice_sum (k̄, kpar̄, ā, r̄, etā) Preserve five argument shapes; native handles broadcast reduction

Additional exceptions: rotation returns a list representing one array gradient; heterogeneous particle clusters return nested lists; basis operators include hidden origin gradients; cylindrical variants expose axial derivatives through pullback_axial.

Reuse existing directional checks in tests/test_linalg.py, tests/test_advect.py, tests/test_plane_fields.py, tests/test_lattice_sum_adjoints.py, and tests/test_internal_bands.py. Include nontrivial complex cotangents to catch conjugation errors, tuple outputs with an unused branch, real-input gradient projection, and repeated backward behavior.

Read-only audit complete; no files changed.
